name: netify-sourcing
description: Research SD-WAN and SASE providers and prepare buyer-approved requests for Netify sourcing desk review.

interface.longDescription: Research provider evidence, prepare a sourcing brief and bundle requests for contacts, demonstrations or proposals. Requests require explicit buyer approval and confirmation by work email before Netify desk review. Evidence matches are not supplier-confirmed recommendations. Supplier response commitments are agreed for each sourcing.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a sourcing plan for my SD-WAN requirement.
Help me request comparable SASE proposals.
